name: Ink Business Unlimited Credit Card: Cash Back

localized_names.en: Ink Business Unlimited Credit Card: Cash Back

apr.notes: 0% intro APR for 12 months from account opening on purchases. After that, 16.74% (min of (6.75+9.99) and 29.99%) to 24.74% (min of (6.75+17.99) and 29.99%) variable APR.

fx_fee.notes: Foreign transaction fee not explicitly stated on product page.

rewards.currency_label: Ultimate Rewards points / cash back (100 points = $1 cash back)

base_rate.description: Unlimited 1.5% cash back on every purchase. Cash Back rewards tracked as points; each $1 in Cash Back = 100 points.

rewards.redemption_notes: Redeem for cash back, gift cards, travel and more through Chase Ultimate Rewards. No minimums to redeem.

signup_bonus.description: Earn $1,000 cash back after you spend $8,000 on purchases in the first 4 months after account opening. (Main page shows $750 with $1,000 struck through; offer details confirm $1,000.)

benefits.title: 0% Intro APR for 12 months
benefits.description: 0% intro APR for 12 months from account opening on purchases.

benefits.title: 5% Cash Back on Lyft rides
benefits.description: Earn 5% total cash back on Lyft rides through September 30, 2027.

benefits.title: Complimentary 3-month Instacart+ membership
benefits.description: Complimentary 3-month Instacart+ membership when activated between 5/1/2025 and 12/31/2027.

benefits.title: Auto Rental Coverage
benefits.description: Coverage is primary when renting for business purposes and provides reimbursement up to $60,000 for theft and collision damage for most rental vehicles with an MSRP of $125,000 or less.

benefits.title: Travel and Emergency Assistance
benefits.description: Provides legal and medical referrals and access to other travel and emergency assistance services.

benefits.title: Roadside Assistance
benefits.description: Roadside service fees billed to card at time of dispatch.

benefits.title: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible new purchases for 120 days against damage or theft up to $10,000 per item.

benefits.title: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends manufacturer's U.S. warranty by an additional year, on eligible warranties of three years or less, up to four years from date of purchase.

benefits.title: Employee cards at no additional cost
benefits.description: Employee cards let you set individual spending limits and help you earn rewards even faster.

notes: Verified from official Chase product page. Network (mastercard) and network_tier (world) not explicitly stated on product page; preserved from existing JSON. FX fee not stated on page; preserved as null. Signup bonus: main page shows '$750' with '$1,000' struck through; offer details confirm '$1,000 Cash Back'.
